stops.note: literally little grandmother, also the headscarf grandmothers typically wore
first appeared in English in an 1834 translation of M. N. Zagoskin's Russian novel 'The Young Muscovite'; the headscarf sense came in the 1930s
stops.meaning: a triangular headscarf tied under the chin

current_meaning: a triangular headscarf tied under the chin, or an old Russian woman
